'''General Danknuck''' was a high ranking [[goblin (race)|goblin]] general who lead the final attempt on the invasion on [[Falador]] during the [[2014 Goblin Invasion]] event. He could only be harmed with an [[event rpg]], and had similar drops to [[Painted Goblin]]s, albeit in higher quantities. He was removed from the game at the end of the event.
